About.title: How to interpret the data
About.introduction: DataEmpregos is an independent visualization of monthly formal-employment movements published through Novo CAGED.
About.dataset: The data originates with Brazil's Ministry of Labor and Employment, through PDET and Novo CAGED.
About.grouping: Results are grouped by geography and CBO occupational family.
About.movements: Admissions and dismissals are recorded movements; they are not a complete count of everyone employed.
About.salary: Average admission salary refers to the admission salary field in the dataset, not the average salary of everyone in an occupational family. Values are nominal Brazilian reais.
About.revisions: Official data can be revised, and this project's processing or presentation may contain omissions, delays, or errors.
About.independence: This is an independent experimental project. It is not an official service and is not supported or endorsed by a government body.
About.officialSource: Consult the official Novo CAGED source

Footer.disclaimer: Independent experimental project. For official or authoritative use, consult the public Novo CAGED source.
